Scope: frontend/dist/app.js — play button prepends a workspace cd to the command.

The change prepends `cd <workspace>` to commands invoked from the play button. The workspace path extraction is guarded with `window.Panels && typeof window.Panels.workspace === "function"`, and the path is quoted via `JSON.stringify()` before being concatenated into the command. When no workspace path is available (`wsPath` falsy), the original command is used unchanged.

No issues survived this check within the reviewed scope. The single proposed defect was refuted by tracing the actual expression: the `&&` short-circuits on `window.Panels` before the `.workspace` property access is evaluated, so neither a `null` nor `undefined` `window.Panels` causes a throw. This was confirmed by a Node runtime reproduction of the exact guard expression.
